نترافع (form VI)
# نَتَرَافَعُ (natarāfaʕu) /na.ta.raː.fa.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَرَافَعَ (tarāfaʕa)
# نَتَرَافَعَ (natarāfaʕa) /na.ta.raː.fa.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَرَافَعَ (tarāfaʕa)
# نَتَرَافَعْ (natarāfaʕ) /na.ta.raː.faʕ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَرَافَعَ (tarāfaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
